name.ja: ラメイソンの<ruby>守<rt>まも</rt></ruby>り<ruby>手<rt>て</rt></ruby>ジュノン

text.en: If this card is in your hand and you have 3 or more Spells with different names in your GY: You can Special Summon this card. You can target 1 "Spellbook" card and 1 Spell in your GY; banish 1 of them, and if you do, add the other to your hand, then if it is a "Spellbook" card, you can destroy 1 card on the field. You can only use each effect of "Protector of the Grand Tower" once per turn.
